etymologies.etymologyHTML: From wheel +‎ chair.

definitions.definition: A chair mounted on large wheels for the transportation or use of a sick or disabled person.

quote.citation: 2021 January 13, Paul Clifton, “Island Line bids farewell to 1930s "icon of transport"...”, in Rail, page 9:
quote.text: "And there are aspirations that we must rightly meet - people travelling in a wheelchair should be able to get on and off the train."

definitions.definition: (attributive) Designed for use by wheelchairbound people.
(by extension) Any device involving wheels designed to assist a non-human animal with locomotion.

quote.citation: 2020 March 1, Gabe Bergado, “Watch this tortoise zip around town in a giant wheelchair”, in The Daily Dot:
quote.text: To build the wheelchair, Dale Ryder attached wheels from a toy plane to an axle that fits over Mrs. T’s shell.
